parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the application group.

For information about how to obtain the application group ID, see [DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~).

parameters.name: GroupMetricRules
parameters.description: The list of metric-based alert rules for the application group.

sub_parameters.name: Category
sub_parameters.description:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

For information about how to obtain the abbreviation, see the `metricCategory` tag in the `Labels` response parameter of the [DescribeProjectMeta](~~114916~~) operation.

sub_parameters.name: ContactGroups
sub_parameters.description:
The alert contact group.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

For information about how to obtain the alert contact group, see [DescribeContactGroupList](~~114922~~).

sub_parameters.name: Dimensions
sub_parameters.description:
The monitoring dimensions of the specified resource.

The value is a collection of `key:value` pairs, such as `{"userId":"120886317861****"}` and `{"instanceId":"i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****"}`.

sub_parameters.name: EffectiveInterval
sub_parameters.description: The effective period of the alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

sub_parameters.name: EmailSubject
sub_parameters.description:
The subject of the alert notification email.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

sub_parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.ComparisonOperator
sub_parameters.description:
The comparison operator for Critical-level alerts. Valid values:

- GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold: greater than or equal to the threshold. 
- GreaterThanThreshold: greater than the threshold. 
- LessThanOrEqualToThreshold: less than or equal to the threshold. 
- LessThanThreshold: less than the threshold. 
- NotEqualToThreshold: not equal to the threshold. 
- GreaterThanYesterday: greater than the value at the same time yesterday. 
- LessThanYesterday: less than the value at the same time yesterday. 
- GreaterThanLastWeek: greater than the value at the same time last week. 
- LessThanLastWeek: less than the value at the same time last week. 
- GreaterThanLastPeriod: greater than the value in the last period. 
- LessThanLastPeriod: less than the value in the last period. 

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

> Set at least one of the alert severity levels Critical, Warn, or Info. For each specified alert severity level, you must set all of the following parameters: Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times.

sub_parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.Statistics
sub_parameters.description:
The statistical method for Critical-level alerts.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

The valid values of this parameter are determined by the `Statistics` column corresponding to the `MetricName` of the specified Alibaba Cloud service, such as Maximum, Minimum, and Average. For information about how to obtain the valid values, see [Cloud service monitoring](~~163515~~).

> Set at least one of the alert severity levels Critical, Warn, or Info. For each specified alert severity level, you must set all of the following parameters: Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times.

sub_parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.Threshold
sub_parameters.description:
The threshold that triggers Critical-level alert notifications.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

> Set at least one of the alert severity levels Critical, Warn, or Info. For each specified alert severity level, you must set all of the following parameters: Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times.

sub_parameters.name: Escalations.Critical.Times
sub_parameters.description:
The number of times that the monitoring metric must reach the alert threshold before a Critical-level alert notification is sent.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

> Settings for at least one of the alert severity levels Critical, Warn (warning), or Info must be specified. For each specified alert severity level, you must set all of the following parameters: Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times.

sub_parameters.name: Interval
sub_parameters.description:
The detection period of the alert rule.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

Unit: seconds. The default value is the minimum reporting frequency of the metric.

> Keep the detection period of the alert rule consistent with the data reporting period. If the detection period is shorter than the data reporting period, alerts may not be triggered due to insufficient data.

sub_parameters.name: Labels
sub_parameters.description: The tag keys of the alert rule.

sub_parameters.name: MetricName
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the metric.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

For information about how to obtain the metric name, see [DescribeMetricMetaList](~~98846~~) or [Cloud service monitoring](~~163515~~).

sub_parameters.name: Namespace
sub_parameters.description:
The namespace of the Alibaba Cloud service.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

For information about how to obtain the namespace of an Alibaba Cloud service, see [DescribeMetricMetaList](~~98846~~) or [Cloud service monitoring](~~163515~~).

sub_parameters.name: NoDataPolicy
sub_parameters.description:
The processing method when no monitoring data is found. Valid values:
- KEEP_LAST_STATE (default): No action is performed.
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA: An alert whose content is "Insufficient Data" is triggered.
- OK: The status is considered normal.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

sub_parameters.name: NoEffectiveInterval
sub_parameters.description: The time period during which the alert rule is ineffective. Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

sub_parameters.name: Options
sub_parameters.description:
The advanced settings.

Format: {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}. For example, {"NotSendOK":true} specifies whether to send an alert recovery notification. The key is NotSendOK, and the value is true (do not send) or false (send, which is the default).

sub_parameters.name: Period
sub_parameters.description:
The reporting period of monitoring data.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200. 

The value of `Period` must be 60 or a multiple of 60. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300.

sub_parameters.name: RuleId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the alert rule.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

sub_parameters.name: RuleName
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the alert rule.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

sub_parameters.name: SilenceTime
sub_parameters.description:
The mute period of the alert notification. Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400. Minimum value: 3600.

sub_parameters.name: Webhook
sub_parameters.description:
The callback URL to which an alert notification is sent. Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

Specify a publicly accessible URL. CloudMonitor sends a POST request to push alert information to this URL. Only the HTTP protocol is supported.
